jobs.title: AI Creative Director
jobs.description:
Superside is seeking a visionary AI Creative Director
with a strong focus on Generative AI to lead a globally distributed team of creatives, delivering innovative work across branding, landing pages, ad and social creative, print design, presentation design, and more. In this pivotal role, you’ll participate in elevating our creative capabilities and integrating cutting-edge AI solutions into our design processes.

As a Creative Director, you will lead the creative vision across multiple customer accounts, including brands like Meta, Amazon, Salesforce, Shopify, and Google, and take full accountability for the quality and consistency of creative output. You will serve as the key creative contact for our customers, helping them solve problems through strategic creative thinking, ensuring our work delivers business impact, and pushing our creative standards forward.

What you'll do

Creative Leadership & Customer Engagement

Own the creative vision for key accounts, partnering with Creative Directors to shape brand expression and output.
Guide conceptual direction and ensure alignment with customer goals across campaigns, content, and formats.
Lead customer calls and creative presentations, offering clear rationale, feedback, and recommendations.
Champion creative quality through direction, feedback, and refinement.

Team Direction & Mentorship

Provide strong, actionable direction to creative teams across disciplines.
Collaborate with Creative Project Managers to ensure alignment between vision, scope, and resources.
Mentor and inspire talent, raising the bar across projects through coaching and feedback.

AI Integration & Innovation

Use Generative AI tools (e.g., MidJourney, Firefly, DALL·E) to support ideation and design when relevant.
Help teams adopt AI to enhance creativity and efficiency, without compromising quality.
Stay ahead of industry trends in AI and creative technologies, sharing insights to maintain Superside’s competitive edge.

What you'll need to succeed

Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively present and articulate creative concepts.
7+ years in creative leadership, preferably in global agencies or fast-paced in-house teams.
Strong portfolio showcasing creative excellence across branding, presentations, and ad creative, with evidence of AI-enhanced work.
Experience leading customer relationships and creative delivery in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and presentation tools like PowerPoint and Keynote.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools like MidJourney, DALL·E, and Adobe Firefly, with a demonstrated ability to integrate them into creative workflows.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a high-performing globally distributed team.
Bias for action, proactive, customer-centric, and execution-driven mindset

*Looking for some tips on how to improve your portfolio? We've got you covered! https://careers.superside.com/building-a-standout-portfolio

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension
of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.title: Vice President of Financial Planning Analysis
jobs.description:
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Location:
Toronto, ON (Hybrid, 3 days in office)
Salary:
$180,000–$200,000
Position Type:
Existing vacancy

About the Opportunity

Our client is a privately held, multi-entity organization with offices across North America and Asia-Pacific and several distinct business lines. The business has grown its top line steadily for decades. Leadership is now investing in finance as the next lever for profitability. The VP, Financial Planning, Analysis & Reporting is a key part of that investment. You’ll build a modern FP&A function, much of it from scratch. You’ll own the consolidated global budget and forecast, management and board reporting, and the data foundation behind them.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Forecasting

Own the consolidated annual budget across all entities, regions and business lines, and lead the upcoming budget cycle shortly after joining
Move the business from a static annual budget to rolling, driver-based forecasts covering volume, margin and FX
Build multi-entity, multi-currency models for scenarios, sensitivities and long-range planning, including shared-service allocations
Turn corporate strategy into financial plans, entity-level targets and regional accountability

Reporting & Performance Management

Deliver monthly management reporting for executive and business unit leaders, tied back to published financials
Prepare board packages with a clear, forward-looking narrative
Lead monthly and quarterly variance reviews, and define and own KPIs for the whole group
Spot trends, risks and profit opportunities across markets and bring them to leadership

Business Partnership & Decision Support

Partner with business unit leaders on budgets, forecasts and performance, with a focus on improving margins
Lead forward-looking quarterly business reviews that lead to action
Build business cases for pricing, investment and capital allocation, including multi-currency ROI and payback analysis

Systems, Data & Team

Partner with IT to strengthen data infrastructure and BI capability across ERP
Reconcile and validate data across sources to establish one trusted version of the numbers
Drive adoption of FP&A tools that can handle multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation

What You Bring

7–10 years of progressive FP&A or commercial finance experience, with recent senior leadership scope
Experience leading consolidated budgeting and forecasting across multiple entities, business lines or countries
Advanced financial modelling skills
Strong accounting foundation and rigor, with reporting that always ties to the published P&L
Executive presence and presentation skills, comfortable presenting to a CEO and board

Next Steps

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance — LCL Group of Companies

Location:
Moncton or Charlo, New Brunswick

Join our team! LCL Group of Companies is hiring an experienced Director of Finance
to lead and take full ownership of the accounting and finance functions across our group of construction companies, including L.C.L. Excavation (2006) Inc, Pavage J.R. Lagacé Paving Inc, and MacArthur's Paving (2026) Inc
.

Reporting directly to the President, this senior leadership role is responsible for overseeing financial operations, ensuring accurate and timely reporting, strengthening internal controls, and leading the accounting team. The Director of Finance will work closely with Operations to support financial performance, sound business decisions, and continuous improvement.

This position offers the opportunity to play an increasingly important role in the group's overall direction and become a key member of the senior leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

Take full ownership and accountability for the accounting and finance functions across the group of companies
Lead month-end and year-end closing processes, including financial statements and consolidated reporting across all companies
Oversee accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, reconciliations, and general ledger management
Manage construction job costing, Work-in-Progress (WIP) reporting, and project financial performance analysis
Work with Operations to review project cost-to-complete forecasts, estimated margins, and cost variances
Lead cash-flow forecasting, working capital management, and financial planning
Develop and oversee annual budgets, financial forecasts, and management reporting
Collaborate with Operations to evaluate profitability, equipment costs, capital expenditures, and opportunities for improvement
Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and consistent financial processes across the group
Lead improvements to Acumatica ERP and related financial systems to increase efficiency and reporting capabilities
Manage relationships with external accountants, financial institutions, and other professional advisors
Build, lead, mentor, and develop a strong and accountable accounting team
Provide financial analysis, insights, and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions
Work closely with the President and senior leadership to support the group's continued growth and long-term financial performance
Develop, streamline, and standardize financial processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and ease of use, establishing reliable controls that allow for oversight and periodic review rather than constant hands-on involvement

What We're Looking For

7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including experience in a senior accounting or financial management role
Proven ability to lead an accounting department, manage teams, and take ownership of financial operations
Strong understanding of financial reporting, accounting principles, internal controls, and multi-company accounting
Experience with construction accounting, job costing, WIP reporting, and project forecasting strongly preferred
CPA designation preferred
Strong budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management, and financial analysis skills
Demonstrated ability to improve financial processes, systems, and departmental performance
Proficiency with ERP systems and Excel; Acumatica experience is an asset
Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work collaboratively with operational teams and communicate financial information clearly
Proactive, accountable, and comfortable making decisions and managing competing priorities
A humble, hardworking, and results-driven approach to leadership

Why Join LCL Group?

Competitive salary
Full-time leadership position
Health and dental insurance
Retirement plan
Opportunity to take ownership of the financial operations of a growing group of construction companies
Direct involvement with the President and the opportunity to become a key member of the senior leadership team
Opportunity to build and develop a strong accounting team and improve financial systems and processes
A respected family-owned construction group with established operations throughout New Brunswick

Are you a hands-on finance leader who thrives in a high-growth environment and enjoys building teams, improving processes, and driving business performance?
We're partnering with a growing facilities services organization to recruit a Director of Finance
. Reporting directly to the President, this role offers the opportunity to shape financial strategy, strengthen reporting and systems, develop the accounting team, and support continued growth through organic expansion and acquisitions.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to combine strategic leadership with hands-on financial oversight. You'll partner with senior leadership and operational teams to improve profitability, establish accountability, implement automation, and prepare the organization for future growth and acquisitions.

Lead finance strategy and align departmental priorities with organizational objectives.
Oversee month-end and year-end close, financial statements, reconciliations, and management reporting.

Partner with Sales and Operations to establish KPIs, monitor performance, and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

CPA designation would be a nice asset to have
Significant progressive experience in accounting and finance leadership, ideally within a high-growth organization.
Construction or industrial services industry background would be an asset
Knowledge of service-based revenue models, including recurring contracts, inspections, and project work.
Experience managing multiple legal entities, intercompany transactions, and consolidation preparation.
Strong financial reporting, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis expertise.
Experience partnering with operational leaders to drive business performance and accountability.
Proven ability to coach and develop accounting teams.
Experience implementing ERP systems, cloud accounting platforms, reporting tools, and automation.
Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

What We Offer

A senior leadership role reporting directly to the President.
The opportunity to influence business strategy and financial performance.
Ownership of finance transformation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Involvement in acquisitions, integration, and organizational growth.
The opportunity to develop a stronger, more scalable finance function.

If you're a commercially minded finance leader who enjoys building, improving, and scaling a business, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs (Regulatory Intelligence)
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases.
You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs (Regulatory Intelligence), will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and interpreting global regulatory developments to ensure the company’s compliance and strategic positioning in the pharmaceutical market. This role involves collecting and disseminating regulatory information, providing insights to internal stakeholders, and supporting the development of regulatory strategies. Supports the Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs (Labeling/Ad-Promo), in efforts to influence the regulatory environment.

Key Accountabilities

Proactively monitors and assesses global regulatory environments for emerging changes in laws, regulations, and guidance impacting drug and device development.
Tracks and evaluates updates from key regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA), industry associations, and external intelligence sources.
Maintains and continuously enhances regulatory intelligence databases and tools to ensure accurate, timely, and efficient dissemination of information.
Analyzes regulatory developments, including guidance documents, policies, and regulations, to determine potential impact on internal processes, development programs, and regulatory strategies. Anticipates and tracks regulatory changes over time, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable updates to impacted stakeholders across the organization.
Partners with Quality to ensure appropriate change control processes are initiated and tracked through implementation when regulatory changes impact internal procedures.
Translates complex regulatory information into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
Develops and delivers regulatory intelligence communications, including newsletters, alerts, trackers, and periodic reports.
Responds to internal inquiries by providing tailored regulatory intelligence summaries and detailed analyses to support decision-making.
Leads and facilitates regulatory intelligence meetings to include review and discussion of ad hoc query requests, regulatory background package requests, health authority guidance, Federal Register notices, public commenting opportunities, newsletter content, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.
Coordinates cross-functional discussions to evaluate the impact of new or revised regulatory requirements. Collaborates closely with key functions, including Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Clinical, CMC, and Regulatory Affairs, to ensure alignment and effective implementation.
Leads the regulatory public commenting process and identifies opportunities to engage with external stakeholders on draft regulations, guidance, and policies.
Supports the development, coordination, and submission of company comments to regulatory authorities and industry organizations.
Confirms the list of upcoming regulatory meetings/workshops/conferences remains current.
Drives continuous improvement of regulatory intelligence processes, systems, and tools to enhance efficiency and value. Authors and conducts periodic review of regulatory intelligence Standard Operating Procedures or work practices.
Manages and maintains internal knowledge management platforms (e.g., SharePoint, intranet) to ensure accessible and up-to-date information. Develops, reviews and updates the Regulatory Intelligence homepage on the Global Regulatory Affairs Portal.
Contributes to cross-functional initiatives and organizational projects by providing regulatory intelligence expertise and strategic insight.
Manages onboarding and offboarding of regulatory intelligence team members and provides input on team member performance. Provides leadership, coaching, and day‑to‑day oversight for direct reports within Global Regulatory Intelligence, fostering their professional growth and development.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, law, public policy, or a related field.
A Master's degree or higher is preferred.
Minimum 8 years’ experience in pharmaceutical regulatory affairs, including 6 years’ experience in regulatory intelligence.
Demonstrates solid working knowledge of the drug, biologic, and device development process, laws, regulations, and guidelines from FDA, EMA, PMDA, ICH, etc.
Demonstrates understanding of the major regional and global industry association priorities (e.g., PhRMA, EFPIA, JPMA, etc.).
Previous interactions with FDA or other health authority are desirable.
Proficient in using regulatory intelligence tools and databases.

Key Competencies

Analytical thinking, problem solving and decision making: Demonstrates strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues, identify risks and opportunities, develop practical and achievable solutions, and make sound, data-driven decisions
Strategic thinking & regulatory innovation: Capable of strategic thinking and proposing innovative solutions involving regulatory issues, while being a team player who invites response and discussion
Performance & accountability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly accountable work environment
Independence & team effectiveness: Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision while also contributing effectively as a collaborative team member. Balances individual accountability with a commitment to supporting team goals, sharing knowledge, and fostering a positive and productive work environment.
Attention to detail: Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, quality, and consistency in all work products
Multitasking: Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks, projects, and competing priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high standards of performance

Key Capabilities

Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do
Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results
Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges
Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language
Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals
Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges
Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges
Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders
Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts
, we strive to be extraordinary
, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity
. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives.
Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world. We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

new_jobs.title: Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs (Regulatory Intelligence)
new_jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases.
You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs (Regulatory Intelligence), will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and interpreting global regulatory developments to ensure the company’s compliance and strategic positioning in the pharmaceutical market. This role involves collecting and disseminating regulatory information, providing insights to internal stakeholders, and supporting the development of regulatory strategies. Supports the Senior Director, Regulatory Affairs (Labeling/Ad-Promo), in efforts to influence the regulatory environment.

Key Accountabilities

Proactively monitors and assesses global regulatory environments for emerging changes in laws, regulations, and guidance impacting drug and device development.
Tracks and evaluates updates from key regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA), industry associations, and external intelligence sources.
Maintains and continuously enhances regulatory intelligence databases and tools to ensure accurate, timely, and efficient dissemination of information.
Analyzes regulatory developments, including guidance documents, policies, and regulations, to determine potential impact on internal processes, development programs, and regulatory strategies. Anticipates and tracks regulatory changes over time, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable updates to impacted stakeholders across the organization.
Partners with Quality to ensure appropriate change control processes are initiated and tracked through implementation when regulatory changes impact internal procedures.
Translates complex regulatory information into clear, actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
Develops and delivers regulatory intelligence communications, including newsletters, alerts, trackers, and periodic reports.
Responds to internal inquiries by providing tailored regulatory intelligence summaries and detailed analyses to support decision-making.
Leads and facilitates regulatory intelligence meetings to include review and discussion of ad hoc query requests, regulatory background package requests, health authority guidance, Federal Register notices, public commenting opportunities, newsletter content, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.
Coordinates cross-functional discussions to evaluate the impact of new or revised regulatory requirements. Collaborates closely with key functions, including Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Clinical, CMC, and Regulatory Affairs, to ensure alignment and effective implementation.
Leads the regulatory public commenting process and identifies opportunities to engage with external stakeholders on draft regulations, guidance, and policies.
Supports the development, coordination, and submission of company comments to regulatory authorities and industry organizations.
Confirms the list of upcoming regulatory meetings/workshops/conferences remains current.
Drives continuous improvement of regulatory intelligence processes, systems, and tools to enhance efficiency and value. Authors and conducts periodic review of regulatory intelligence Standard Operating Procedures or work practices.
Manages and maintains internal knowledge management platforms (e.g., SharePoint, intranet) to ensure accessible and up-to-date information. Develops, reviews and updates the Regulatory Intelligence homepage on the Global Regulatory Affairs Portal.
Contributes to cross-functional initiatives and organizational projects by providing regulatory intelligence expertise and strategic insight.
Manages onboarding and offboarding of regulatory intelligence team members and provides input on team member performance. Provides leadership, coaching, and day‑to‑day oversight for direct reports within Global Regulatory Intelligence, fostering their professional growth and development.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, law, public policy, or a related field.
A Master's degree or higher is preferred.
Minimum 8 years’ experience in pharmaceutical regulatory affairs, including 6 years’ experience in regulatory intelligence.
Demonstrates solid working knowledge of the drug, biologic, and device development process, laws, regulations, and guidelines from FDA, EMA, PMDA, ICH, etc.
Demonstrates understanding of the major regional and global industry association priorities (e.g., PhRMA, EFPIA, JPMA, etc.).
Previous interactions with FDA or other health authority are desirable.
Proficient in using regulatory intelligence tools and databases.

Key Competencies

Analytical thinking, problem solving and decision making: Demonstrates strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues, identify risks and opportunities, develop practical and achievable solutions, and make sound, data-driven decisions
Strategic thinking & regulatory innovation: Capable of strategic thinking and proposing innovative solutions involving regulatory issues, while being a team player who invites response and discussion
Performance & accountability: Comfortable in a fast-paced, results-driven, and highly accountable work environment
Independence & team effectiveness: Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision while also contributing effectively as a collaborative team member. Balances individual accountability with a commitment to supporting team goals, sharing knowledge, and fostering a positive and productive work environment.
Attention to detail: Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, quality, and consistency in all work products
Multitasking: Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks, projects, and competing priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high standards of performance

Key Capabilities

Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do
Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results
Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges
Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language
Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals
Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges
Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges
Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders
Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts
, we strive to be extraordinary
, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity
. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives.
Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world. We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
